children: Indonesia's Stock Exchange said on Friday it has taken concrete steps to enhance transparency and integrity in capital market, responding to an MSCI announcement that it was considering a downgrade to standalone- from emerging-market status.
The exchange said respects MSCI's independence in conducting assessments and will request further clarification on the basis for the announcement, its CEO Jeffrey Hendrik said in a statement.
